info.title: ElSpa Payroll System API
info.description:
Complete RESTful API for ElSpa payroll management system.

Features:
- Employee management (CRUD)
- Cash Advance (CA) tracking and settlement
- Attendance logging with OT/late calculations
- Philippine holiday management
- Payroll period management
- Automated payroll calculation with detailed breakdown
- Payroll approval workflow

**Authentication:** JWT Bearer tokens (required for all endpoints in production)

**Error Handling:** All endpoints return appropriate HTTP status codes with error messages

**Pagination:** List endpoints support skip/limit parameters

Create a new employee record in the payroll system.

Employee types:
- therapist: Service therapist (can have commission)
- nail: Nail technician (can have commission)
- driver: Transportation driver (eligible for meal allowance)

- hollys: Hollys Coffee staff
- manager: Manager/admin

Pay groups:
- weekly: Weekly payroll cycle
- biweekly: Bi-weekly payroll cycle

post.description:
Create a new cash advance request.

Status transitions:
- pending (initial) → approved (by manager) → settled (at payroll calculation)
- pending → rejected (by manager)

**Business Logic:**
- Pending CA cannot be deducted from payroll
- Only approved CA is eligible for deduction
- CA is automatically marked as settled when included in payroll calculation
- settled_payroll_id tracks which payroll record settled this CA

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of cash advances with optional status filter

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return

put.description:
Update the status of a cash advance request.

Valid status values:
- pending: Initial state
- approved: Approved by manager
- rejected: Rejected by manager
- settled: Automatically set during payroll calculation

**Note:** Usually only pending → approved or pending → rejected transitions are manual.
settled is set automatically by the payroll calculation system.

post.description:
Record work day attendance with clock-in/out times.

**Automatic Calculations:**
- late_minutes: Deducted if > 0 (10 pesos per minute if exceeds 10 min)
- overtime_minutes: Calculated if >= 40 minutes (additional pay)
- holiday_type: Affects pay multiplier (national=200%, special=130%)

**Holiday Types:**
- "none": Regular workday
- "national": National holiday (200% pay rate)
- "special": Special holiday (130% pay rate)

Register a Philippine holiday in the system.

**Holiday Types and Rate Multipliers:**
- national: 200% pay (full rate = 2.0)
- special: 130% pay (full rate = 1.3)

Employees working on holidays receive additional pay at these rates.

post.description:
Create a new payroll period for processing employee salaries.

**Business Rules:**
- period_start < period_end (required)
- Multiple employees can be processed in one period
- Initial status is "draft"

**Status Workflow:**
- draft: Initial state, can calculate payroll
- approved: Ready for payment
- paid: Payment completed

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of payroll periods

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return

get.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific payroll period

post.description:
Advance the payroll period through its workflow states.

**Status Transitions (validation):**
- draft → approved (payroll has been calculated)
- approved → paid (payment has been processed)
- paid (no further transitions allowed)

**What happens:**
1. Period status is updated
2. All associated PayrollRecords status is also updated to match
3. Returns updated period details

**Error Cases:**
- 404: Period not found
- 409: Invalid transition (e.g., paid period cannot be re-approved)

get.description: Retrieve detailed payroll calculation for a specific employee in a period

post.description:
Execute automated payroll calculation for all employees in a period.

**What happens:**
1. Retrieves all employees with matching pay_group
2. Collects attendance logs for the period
3. Calculates each employee's salary:
   - Base salary (prorated if needed)
   - Commission (if applicable)
   - Overtime pay (40+ minutes)
   - Holiday bonuses
   - Deductions (late, absence, CA, etc.)
4. Creates PayrollRecord entries for each employee
5. Marks approved CA as "settled" and links to PayrollRecord

**Income Components:**
- base_amount: Regular salary
- commission_amount: Performance-based (therapist/nail)
- overtime_amount: Hours over 8/day
- holiday_bonus: Premium pay on holidays
- meal_allowance: Driver perks

**Deduction Components:**
- late_deduction: 10 pesos/minute if > 10 min
- absence_deduction: Full day rate if absent
- sss_deduction: Social security contribution
- ca_deduction: Approved cash advances
- health_check_deduction: Medical checkup cost
- thirteenth_month_deduction: 13th month bonus advance

**Returns:**
- List of PayrollRecords with complete breakdown
- Each record shows gross_pay, total_deductions, net_pay

**Important:**
- Calculates based on attendance data in the period
- Missing attendance = absent day
- Calling again on same period recalculates (overwrites previous)

settled_payroll_id.description: Payroll record ID that settled this CA

rate_multiplier.description: Pay rate multiplier (2.0 for national, 1.3 for special)

period_end.description: Period end date (YYYY-MM-DD), must be after start
